title: File Upload
description: A dropzone that says what it accepts, and a list that shows what it got.
usage: For attachments and imports. State the accepted types and the size limit on the zone itself — not in a help article the user will never open.
a11y: The zone is a real label for a real file input, so keyboard and screen-reader users browse the same way. Dropped files join the same list as browsed ones, each removable.
